security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code formatting, documentation links, and workflow language. Two risks remain: a user-controlled campaign value is interpolated into a shell command, and the same value is used in a saved filename without an explicit path-safety rule. No prompt-injection language or exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: User-controlled campaign text is interpolated into the ledger shell command.
remediation.suggestion: Pass the campaign name as a separately escaped argument or use a tool API without shell interpolation. Reject shell metacharacters and use a fixed argument list.

remediation.issue: User-controlled campaign text forms part of the results filename.
remediation.suggestion: Convert campaign names to a safe slug, reject path separators and dot segments, and verify the resolved path remains under memory/ad/paid-measurement-loop/.

content.user_title: Evaluate Paid Campaign Changes Against Controls
content.value_statement: Paid campaign changes are difficult to judge when attribution, currency, and learning periods differ. This skill defines a fixed readback window and compares normalized ROAS or CPA with a control.
actual_capabilities: Defines a fixed readback window after a campaign exits learning phase.
Selects a control campaign, ad set, or holdout for comparison.
Compares ROAS or CPA delta against the selected control.
Identifies attribution-window, currency, conversion-lag, and tracking issues.
Labels a result Promote, Keep-testing, Rollback, or Unproven.
Prepares a handoff summary for reporting or audit workflows.
limitations: Requires user-provided exports or optional account integrations.
Does not calculate ROAS or CPA ratios itself.
Cannot prove causation without a suitable control and clean measurement.
Does not replace platform-specific statistical or compliance review.

use_cases.title: Review a budget increase
use_cases.description: Compare a budget change with an unchanged control after a defined readback window.

use_cases.title: Assess new creative
use_cases.description: Determine whether a new creative set improved ROAS or CPA without reacting to early noise.

use_cases.title: Prepare stakeholder evidence
use_cases.description: Create a documented campaign decision with normalization notes and measurement limitations.

prompt_templates.title: Start a campaign readback
prompt_templates.prompt: Read back my Campaign X budget increase from two weeks ago. I have a campaign export and an unchanged control.

prompt_templates.title: Compare creative performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my new prospecting creative with the previous creative using CPA. Use a 14-day window and identify a suitable control.

prompt_templates.title: Normalize cross-platform results
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate Meta and Google Search ROAS after my changes. Normalize currency and attribution windows before comparing the controls.

prompt_templates.title: Handle measurement uncertainty
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this campaign change. Conversion tracking may be duplicated, so identify the evidence needed and return Unproven if it cannot be verified.

output_examples.input: A campaign budget increased after learning phase, with a matched control and 14 days of exports.
output: Primary metric: ROAS improved against the control.
Notes: Attribution window and currency were normalized.

output_examples.input: New creative has seven days of data, but the control is missing.
output: Reason: No valid control exists for the fixed readback window.
Next step: Select an unchanged sibling campaign or holdout.

best_practices: Set the readback window before reviewing results.
Use an unchanged control measured over the same period.
Normalize attribution windows and currency before cross-platform comparisons.
anti_patterns: Do not decide from a raw before-and-after comparison.
Do not act while the campaign remains in learning phase.
Do not present estimated values as measured results.

faq.question: What decision types can this skill return?
faq.answer: It returns Promote, Keep-testing, Rollback, or Unproven.

faq.question: Do I need ad platform API access?
faq.answer: No. The skill supports manually exported data from accounts you control.

faq.question: What metrics does it use?
faq.answer: It evaluates a primary ROAS or CPA metric against a control.

faq.question: Why is a control required?
faq.answer: A control helps separate the campaign change from market noise and timing effects.

faq.question: What happens when conversion tracking is unreliable?
faq.answer: The result is Unproven until tracking is repaired and the fixed window is restarted.

faq.question: Does this skill calculate ROAS and CPA?
faq.answer: No. It delegates ratio calculations to the referenced roi-calculator workflow.
